name = Renew JHotDraw
mainClass = CH.ifa.draw.DrawPlugin
provides = ch.ifa.draw
requires = de.renew.util,de.renew.windowmanagement
version = 2.0.0
versionDate = 2022-02-04

# Known properties
# ----------------
# For documentation, see JavaDoc of class CH.ifa.draw.util.GuiProperties.

# a) numeric values	
### The DrawingLoadServer is started at port 65111 if the property is not set
de.renew.loadServerPort=<not set>
de.renew.defaultFontSize=<not set>
de.renew.menuFontSize=<not set>
de.renew.defaultFontName=<not set>
### Number of drawings listed in the recently saved menu (dynamically checked)
ch.ifa.draw.num-of-recent-files=10

# b) boolean flags
de.renew.windowResizable=false
de.renew.avoidFrameReshape=false
de.renew.customToolBorders=false
de.renew.noGraphics=false
### allow hotkeys for recently saved files
### (must be available at start-up)
ch.ifa.draw.show-recentlysaved-hotkeys=false
### workaround to bring window frames to front on certain os 
### (must be available at start-up)
ch.ifa.draw.window-focus-workaround=false

# c) specific properties
# smoothing strategy of polygon figure (alignment (default), distances, off)
ch.ifa.draw.polygon.smoothing=alignment

# d) ToolButton Key Mapping
# use upper case letters for sticky function
# use Selection Tool to undo sticky function
# use name of tool as suffix to define new map entries
# (be careful not to use duplicate keys)
de.renew.keymap.use-mapping=false
de.renew.keymap.Selection_Tool=.
de.renew.keymap.Transition_Tool=t
de.renew.keymap.Place_Tool=p
de.renew.keymap.Virtual_Place_Tool=v
de.renew.keymap.Arc_Tool=a
de.renew.keymap.Test_Arc_Tool=x
de.renew.keymap.Reserve_Arc_Tool=r
de.renew.keymap.Flexible_Arc_Tool=f
de.renew.keymap.Inscription_Tool=i
de.renew.keymap.Name_Tool=n
de.renew.keymap.Declaration_Tool=d


# e) grid settings
ch.ifa.draw.grid.size=5
ch.ifa.draw.grid.default=false

name = Renew FreeHep Export
mainClass = de.renew.export.io.exportFormats.ExportPlugin
provides = de.renew.export
requires = de.renew.util,ch.ifa.draw
version = 2.0.0
versionDate = 2022-02-04

# Known properties
# ----------------

#Page Size possible values are A3,A4,A5,A6,International,Letter,Legal,Executive,Ledger and BoundingBox
#This value only works for PDF export
de.renew.export.io.pageSize = BoundingBox

#Page orientation possible values are Portrait or Landscape
#This value only works for PDF export
de.renew.export.io.pageOrientation = Portrait

#EPS font handling possible values are Embed, Shapes or None
de.renew.export.io.epsFontHandling = Shapes

# set the background color of EPS transparent 
# dynamic boolean property (is determined during method call)
de.renew.export.io.eps-transparency = false

name = Renew Remote
mainClass = de.renew.remote.RemotePlugin
provides = de.renew.remote
requires = de.renew.simulator
version = 2.0.0
versionDate = 2022-02-04

# User-configurable plugin properties
# -----------------------------------

# Plugin configuration file for the Renew Simulator plugin

# Plugin specification properties
# -------------------------------
name = Renew Simulator
mainClass = de.renew.application.SimulatorPlugin
provides = de.renew.simulator
requires = de.renew.util
version = 2.0.0
versionDate = 2022-02-04


# User-configurable properties
# ----------------------------

# A) Simulation engine
# Note: simulatorMode combines simulatorClass and 
#       simulatorMultiplicity, but can be overridden
#       by the other two properties.
de.renew.simulatorMode = 1
de.renew.simulatorClass = <not set>
de.renew.simulatorMultiplicity = <not set>
de.renew.eagerSimulation = false
de.renew.netPath = <not set>
de.renew.classReinit = false
de.renew.simulatorPriority = <not set>

# B) Remote access
de.renew.remote.enable = false
de.renew.remote.publicName = default
de.renew.remote.serverClass = de.renew.remote.ServerImpl
de.renew.remote.socketFactory = <not set>

# C) Database backing
de.renew.simdb.driver = <not set>
de.renew.simdb.dialect = de.renew.database.entitylayer.SQLDialect
de.renew.simdb.url = <not set>
de.renew.simdb.user = <not set>
de.renew.simdb.password = <not set>
